scenes.title: 폴더를 열면 나타나는 모듈 지도
scenes.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic desktop software concept screenshot, landscape 16:10, not a collage. This is a new concept called 'Depth Lens', a transparent always-on-top desktop companion that explains a CLI-generated project folder as connected code modules. Full computer desktop visible, no physical monitor, no perspective, no futuristic holograms. A restrained warm charcoal desktop wallpaper, a normal Windows-style file manager on the left showing a selected folder named trail-store and files Checkout.tsx, pricing.ts, cart.ts, catalog.ts, products.json. A normal terminal window partially behind at bottom left shows '> create trail-store' and '> done'. A large genuine TRANSLUCENT smoked-glass floating panel occupies the right two-thirds; the wallpaper and underlying window silhouettes remain visibly discernible through its unused areas, 65% tint and subtle backdrop blur. All labels have readable opaque small backing surfaces. Panel title 'Depth Lens' / 'trail-store'. Main graph contains only SIX nodes arranged with ample space and specific distinct silhouettes: Checkout.tsx lavender wide component, cart.ts amber state capsule, pricing.ts cyan function card, catalog.ts green service card, products.json mint stacked data card, Checkout.test.ts slate test tile. Directed visible lines Checkout.tsx -> cart.ts, Checkout.tsx -> pricing.ts, Checkout.tsx -> catalog.ts, catalog.ts -> products.json, Checkout.test.ts -> Checkout.tsx. No extra edges. Short line labels 'imports', 'reads', 'tests' only where spacious. Small right detail footer 'pricing.ts / Used by Checkout.tsx / Open source'. Deliberately practical UI, precise large text, subtle borders, modest rounded corners, no overwhelming glow, no tiny data dashboards. Main focus is the readable module graph floating over real desktop windows, NOT another full opaque IDE. Top compact controls 'Overview', 'Focus', 'Pin'. Bottom pill 'Drag panel  |  Interaction on  |  Opacity 65%'. Small visible 'CONCEPT' label. Consistent role colors and sensible connectors, no crossing text, no metrics or fabricated success claims.
